page_title: COM 0-0 ATA | Como v Atalanta 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Lovely cross from Martin Baturina to find Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) deep in the box, but he steers his header well over the bar.
90+8' Martin Baturina (Como) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

90+8' Nico Paz (Como) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Marco Carnesecchi anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
90+7' Nico Paz (Como) is going to take the penalty!
90+7' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+6' The Como players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+4' Referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Como. Let’s see what happens!
90+4' That looked a certain handball by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+3' Martin Baturina (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90+3' Como hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle as Alvaro Morata (Como) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Martin Baturina (Como) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

90' That's unlucky! Jesus Rodriguez (Como) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Como win a corner.

88' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
87' Here is a change. Lucas Da Cunha is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Sergi Roberto (Como).
86' It is time for a substitution. Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) is on for Raoul Bellanova.
86' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
85' Nico Paz (Como) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
84' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

83' Jacobo Ramon (Como) unleashes a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Marco Carnesecchi thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
82' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) attempts to find Nikola Krstovic, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
81' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
80' The referee is firm and issues Lucas Da Cunha (Como) a deserved yellow card.
80' The substitution is prepared. Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jayden Addai.
79' Ederson (Atalanta) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
76' Alvaro Morata (Como) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi is prepared and dives to thwart him.
76' Poor challenge! Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is penalised for tripping and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle. Como have a free kick.
75' Wasted opportunity! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
74' Alvaro Morata (Como) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
73' A snap shot from distance by Martin Baturina (Como) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
72' It looks like Alex Valle (Como) saw red with that tackle. Luca Pairetto won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
71' Martin Baturina (Como) releases Nico Paz with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
70' The total number of attempts is 20:5. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:2.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jayden Addai (Como) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is first to the cross from Lorenzo Bernasconi, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
68' Nico Paz (Como) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
67' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and signals a foul after Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) brought his opponent down. Como are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
65' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
65' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Jean Butez punches the ball away.
64' A cross from the by-line finds Jayden Addai (Como) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Charles De Ketelaere walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta).
58' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Maximo Perrone and he is replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Alvaro Morata (Como) is replacing Anastasios Douvikas.
58' Jayden Addai (Como) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Anastasios Douvikas.
55' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
54' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Anastasios Douvikas slides a brilliant pass into Jacobo Ramon (Como), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
50' Lucas Da Cunha delivers a perfect cross for Jacobo Ramon (Como), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.
49' Martin Baturina (Como) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
48' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

47' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the right side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Jean Butez. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda is replaced by Jayden Addai (Como).
46' Half-time substitution. Raffaele Palladino decided to make a change. Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is replaced by Raoul Bellanova.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Martin Baturina (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

45+1' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Marco Carnesecchi, who pulls off a stunning save!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Marten de Roon (Atalanta) for his blatant foul. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) will miss the next game.
43' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

42' He should have scored! Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Jacobo Ramon (Como) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Marco Carnesecchi. The linesman points to the corner flag, Como are going to take it.
42' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
42' Nico Paz (Como) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Now Como have a corner.
41' Martin Baturina (Como) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
40' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jean Butez, who smothers the ball.
39' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) volleys the ball towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save to keep the ball out.
38' Maximo Perrone (Como) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
38' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the corner.

37' Nico Paz (Como) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Marco Carnesecchi. Maximo Perrone (Como) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
36' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Jean Butez (Como).

36' Nico Paz (Como) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
34' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Marco Carnesecchi makes a great save to stop his effort.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:2. 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
31' Martin Baturina (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
30' The foul by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
28' Jacobo Ramon (Como) evades his marker in the box and connects beautifully with the corner from Lucas Da Cunha. Unfortunately for him, the ball just zips a few inches past the left post.
28' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lucas Da Cunha (Como).
27' Jacobo Ramon (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Como will have an opportunity.
26' Maximo Perrone (Como) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
24' Jacobo Ramon (Como) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
24' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) jumps into a tackle and Luca Pairetto signals a foul. That's a free kick to Como.
23' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jacobo Ramon (Como) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
23' Ivan Smolcic (Como) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
21' Ederson (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to release Davide Zappacosta with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
18' Here is the reaction to a red card. Raffaele Palladino makes a tactical substitution, Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) leaves the pitch and Kamaldeen Sulemana comes on.
18' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is first to react to a lofted pass from Alex Valle, but fires his header miles over the bar from near the penalty spot.
16' Maximo Perrone (Como) attempts to feed Alex Valle with a chip pass, but Marco Carnesecchi reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
16' The ball possession is 73:27.
15' Como keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
12' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latches onto a short pass from Martin Baturina inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.
10' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the bottom left corner, but Jean Butez denies him.
9' This is a yellow card! Maximo Perrone (Como) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
9' Maximo Perrone (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
8' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
7' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
3' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
